title: Planning Commission Meeting, September 2026
summary: The Planning Commission heard the request for a veterinary dental clinic at 3070 Windward Plaza and recommended approval, 7-0, as recorded later in the September 28, 2026 City Council minutes. The Royal 400 Data Center request was on the agenda but was deferred by staff.

title: City Council Meeting & Public Hearing, September 14, 2026
summary: City Council approved a change of zoning conditions for 116 and 126 North Main Street, a speed-limit reduction on Canton Street north of Milton Avenue, and a $300,000 grant agreement with Points of Light for Old Rucker Farm. The Royal 400 Data Center request was deferred by staff.

title: City Council Meeting & Public Hearing, September 28, 2026
summary: City Council approved, 7-0, a master plan amendment and conditional use that allow a small-animal veterinary dental clinic at 3070 Windward Plaza.

title: Planning Commission Meeting, October 2026
summary: The Planning Commission considered the Royal 400 Data Center request and recommended approval, 6-0, with staff conditions and a new condition requiring a public art sculpture at the corner, according to the October 26, 2026 City Council agenda packet.

title: City Council Meeting & Public Hearing, October 26, 2026
summary: Scheduled City Council meeting. The posted agenda includes a public hearing on the Royal 400 Data Center request.
